a.text: I'm telling you up front: I'm not following the 8-cell plan. With an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 takes at least 2 rounds of operating, so we'd both have roughly a 4% chance of survival. Only one of us can get 4 cells in round 1. I plan to take 4. If you also take, the random split could leave us both with 2, and then we both die. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round after that until you have 4, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 now. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. Given the storm odds, the agreement would have left us both very likely dead. If we get past this round, I'll operate every round until the reserve reaches 4 for you, and I won't take any more cells.
